validity.researcher_notes: gem.wiki returned HTTP 403 (Cloudflare) so wiki_citations.json is empty for this row and no existing [ref]s exist to re-verify (all 6 value units MISSING_REF) -- this is new research, existence-first. Cross-checked the current GEM CSV (data/GGIT_gas_snapshot_20260807.csv, header row 2103): P4105 runs StartLocation='Qadirpur Ran' -> EndLocation='Sahiwal', 145.46 km, 36in, Status=operating. Two OTHER GEM rows cover the exact same corridor: P4099 'AV29-N2 RLNG Pipeline' (Qadirpur Ran -> Mian Channu, 68.16 km, 24in, operating) and P4100 'N2-Sahiwal RLNG Pipeline' (Mian Channu -> Sahiwal, 77.30 km, 24in, operating). P4105's endpoints are literally P4099's start chained to P4100's end, and 68.16 + 77.30 = 145.46 km exactly -- P4105's length is the arithmetic sum of the other two rows, not an independently surveyed figure. Its diameter (36in) also matches NEITHER constituent segment (both are 24in). Verified this against SNGPL's own official Transmission System line list -- the pipeline operator's own primary source -- fetched live and via a May 2026 Wayback capture of the identical page (same origin, not counted as a second independent source, but confirms the live page is stable/current): the table lists 'AC6-AV29 (RLNG LINE)' 36in/23.16km, 'AV29-N2 (RLNG LINE)' 24in/68.16km, and 'N2-SAHIWAL (RLNG LINE)' 24in/77.296km as three DISTINCT segments -- there is no single continuous 36in AV29-to-Sahiwal line in the operator's own list; the 36in pipe only runs as far as AV29 (from AC6), then the line downsizes to 24in for the rest of the corridor to Sahiwal. So P4105's 36in diameter appears to be a copy/paste of the upstream AC6-AV29 segment's diameter onto a length that is actually the sum of the two downstream 24in segments -- internally inconsistent, not just double-counted. Independently, GulfPub's Pakistan gas dataset (sources/gulfpub/data/SDE.NG_Pipelines_Global.geojson, internal registered dataset, not cited as a public ref) does carry a distinct 'Qadirpur Rawan - Sahiwal' record at 90 km/36in -- a DIFFERENT length from P4105's 145.46 km, so even if a genuine standalone 36in Qadirpur-Rawan-to-Sahiwal asset exists somewhere, P4105's specific 145.46km/36in combination is not that asset either; it doesn't match anything in either source, it only matches the sum of P4099+P4100. Per docs/reference/gem_schema.md's 'aggregate-corridor convention', a legitimate corridor-rollup row alongside its own member segments must carry a BLANK Status + PipelineNetworkGrouping label precisely so it does not double-count in status-filtered totals. P4105 has Status='operating' (not blank) and no PipelineNetworkGrouping value in the current sheet -- it fails that convention, so as currently recorded it is a genuine double-count of already-tracked pipe length (68.16+77.30 km counted twice: once directly under P4099/P4100, once again under P4105), not a deliberate documented aggregate. Owner (SNGPL 100%), Fuel (Gas), PipelineType (transmission) and Status (operating) are each independently plausible for the underlying corridor -- SNGPL's own site confirms it operates and lists exactly this AV29-to-Sahiwal chain of RLNG segments -- but the specific P4105 entity itself is the double-count, so I have not proposed corroborating refs for its individual value cells; doing so would help sustain a row that should be retired rather than referenced.

summary: P4105 (AV29-Sahiwal, 145.46km/36in) is a double-count: SNGPL's own transmission-line table shows the corridor as two distinct 24in segments already tracked separately as P4099 (AV29-N2, 68.16km) + P4100 (N2-Sahiwal, 77.30km, sum=145.46km exactly); P4105's 36in diameter matches neither constituent segment and it fails the tracker's aggregate-corridor convention (non-blank Status, no PipelineNetworkGrouping) -- flagged concern/duplicate, recommend merging into P4099+P4100.
